_note: Type spec, not a tuner — variant B (engraved spaced caps, native beside). The committed type system for the map. Consumed by ho-07 (town labels) and ho-09 (peak labels, interaction cards).

fonts.native: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho','Songti SC','Noto Serif JP',serif

rules.hierarchy: by case + tracking + size, not boxes or colour: peak owns cap-height and tracking; settlement steps down to a tighter, smaller cap; elevation is a quiet italic figure
rules.nativeGloss: set beside the latin at near-equal optical size (0.85) — a co-equal name, not a footnote
rules.terracotta: NOT used by type in B — accent stays reserved for the city tower-block (session 2). Settlement-name terracotta was variant C, rejected.
rules.verified: settlement caps hold at 60%; peak holds over a contour fragment
